findings.title: Async forEach is fire-and-forget, calendar/video deletions never awaited
findings.body: File packages/app-store/vital/lib/reschedule.ts line 125 uses bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => {...await getCalendar...}). forEach does not await async callbacks, so Reschedule returns true and sends the reschedule email before deleteEvent/deleteMeeting complete, rejections become unhandled, and the surrounding try/catch cannot catch them because the promises escape the try block.

findings.title: Async forEach is fire-and-forget, calendar/video deletions never awaited
findings.body: File packages/app-store/wipemycalother/lib/reschedule.ts line 125 uses bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => {...await getCalendar...}). forEach does not await async callbacks, so the function returns before deleteEvent/deleteMeeting finish, errors are unhandled, and the surrounding try/catch is ineffective for the now-async getCalendar/delete calls.

findings.title: Async forEach leaves calendar/video cleanup unawaited on reschedule
findings.body: File packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/bookings.tsx line 553 uses bookingRefsFiltered.forEach(async (bookingRef) => {...await getCalendar... return calendar?.deleteEvent...}). The returned promises are discarded, so old calendar events and video meetings may never be deleted before the response/emails proceed, and any rejection from the dynamic import or deleteEvent is unhandled.

findings.title: Async forEach pushes to apiDeletes after it is already awaited, losing recurring cancellations
findings.body: File packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts around line 458 does bookingToDelete.user.credentials.filter(...).forEach(async (credential) => { const calendar = await getCalendar(...); ... apiDeletes.push(deletedEvent); }). Because the callback awaits before pushing, the outer flow reaches await Promise.all(prismaPromises.concat(apiDeletes)) before the pushes happen. Recurring-booking calendar deletions are therefore lost and old events remain on external calendars while the booking is marked CANCELLED.
